headword: ご{苦労|くろう}さまです
gloss: thank you for your hard work; thanks for the trouble

definitions.gloss: thank you for your hard work; thanks for the trouble
definitions.explanation: An expression used to thank someone for their effort or labor, typically said by someone of higher status to someone of lower status. Carries a nuance of acknowledging the difficulty of the work.

examples.japanese: ご{苦労|くろう}さまです。
examples.english: Thank you for your hard work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{配達員|はいたついん}→配達員：20275_haitatsuin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ご{苦労|くろう}さまです⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I said 'thank you for the trouble' to the delivery person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、{遠|とお}く⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ご{苦労|くろう}さまでした。
examples.english: Thank you for coming all the way here in the rain.

notes:
An important social expression in Japanese with strict usage rules based on social hierarchy.

USAGE RULES:
- Used by a superior to a subordinate, or to service workers (delivery people, repairmen, etc.)
- NOT appropriate from a subordinate to a superior — use お{疲|つか}れさまです instead
- Using ご{苦労|くろう}さまです to a boss or senior colleague is considered rude
- ご{苦労|くろう}さまでした (past tense) is used when the work is completed

COMMON VARIATIONS:
- ご⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧さま: slightly less formal
- ご{苦労|くろう}さまでした: past tense, used when work is done
- ご⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧さん: casual, among friends or to children

SIMILAR WORDS:
- お{疲|つか}れさまです: thank you for your work — safe to use with anyone, including superiors
- お{疲|つか}れさまでした: thank you for your work (completed) — the standard end-of-day greeting
